# ShipTickets.bd

> Saint Martin ship tickets, made simple.

ShipTickets.bd is a Bangladesh-focused information and human-assisted booking website for Saint Martin ship tickets from Cox's Bazar. Compare ships, check fares, verify schedules and contact our support team on WhatsApp or phone before you travel.

**Website:** [https://www.shiptickets.bd/](https://www.shiptickets.bd/)
**Full content for LLMs:** [https://www.shiptickets.bd/llms-full.txt](https://www.shiptickets.bd/llms-full.txt)
**Sitemap:** [https://www.shiptickets.bd/sitemap.xml](https://www.shiptickets.bd/sitemap.xml)
**RSS feed:** [https://www.shiptickets.bd/rss.xml](https://www.shiptickets.bd/rss.xml)
**Information last reviewed:** 5 October 2026
**Current season:** 2026-2027, opening 1 November 2026

## Overview

This site does **not** run a live booking engine or inventory system. It provides verified reference information about Saint Martin passenger ships, ticket classes, fares, schedules and government rules. Use it to research, then confirm the latest availability, fare and Travel Pass requirements with a real support agent on WhatsApp or phone before payment.

All information is seasonal. **Saint Martin island access and ship operations are seasonal. The 2026-2027 tourist season opens on 1 November 2026. Sailing dates, departure times and fares are confirmed by the operator for each date.** Every page shows an information-last-reviewed date and a clear status.

## Ships operating Cox's Bazar to Saint Martin

### 1. MV Karnafuly Express (কর্ণফুলী এক্সপ্রেস)

- **Page:** [https://www.shiptickets.bd/saint-martin-ship/karnafuly-express](https://www.shiptickets.bd/saint-martin-ship/karnafuly-express)
- **Route:** Cox's Bazar → Saint Martin
- **Operator:** Karnafuly Shipbuilding & Engineering
- **Status:** Seasonal confirmation required — 2026-2027 season opens 1 November 2026
- **Last reviewed:** 5 October 2026
- **One-way fare (reference):** From ৳1,800
- **Round-trip fare (reference):** From ৳3,500
- **Ticket classes:** Lavender Economy Seat (৳1,800 / ৳3,500), Marigold Economy Seat (৳1,800 / ৳3,500), Open Deck (৳2,100 / ৳4,000), Gladiolus Business Seat (৳2,600 / ৳5,000), Lilac Lounge (৳2,700 / ৳5,300), Chrysanthemum Lounge (৳2,900 / ৳5,600)
- **Cabins:** Single Cabin — 1 passenger, from ৳3,300 one way; Twin Cabin — 2 passengers, from ৳7,000 one way; VIP Cabin — Private cabin, from ৳8,500 one way; VVIP Cabin — Private cabin, from ৳10,500 one way
- **Facilities:** Indoor seating, Open deck, Premium lounge seating, Restaurant / food service, Washrooms, Prayer room, Cabin accommodation, Passenger service areas
- **Journey:** Approx. 5 hours (seasonal — confirm for your sailing)
- **Departure:** Morning departure (seasonal — confirm exact time)
- **Check-in:** Arrive before the published departure time; final check-in is confirmed on your ticket

### 2. MV Baro Awlia (বারো আওলিয়া)

- **Page:** [https://www.shiptickets.bd/saint-martin-ship/baro-awlia](https://www.shiptickets.bd/saint-martin-ship/baro-awlia)
- **Route:** Cox's Bazar → Saint Martin
- **Operator:** Baro Awlia Shipping
- **Status:** Seasonal confirmation required — 2026-2027 season opens 1 November 2026
- **Last reviewed:** 5 October 2026
- **One-way fare (reference):** From ৳1,800
- **Round-trip fare (reference):** From ৳3,500
- **Ticket classes:** Main Deck Seat (৳1,800 / ৳3,500), Sun Deck Seat (৳1,800 / ৳3,500), Panorama Business Chair (৳2,100 / ৳4,000), Riviera Business Chair (৳2,100 / ৳4,000), Mozarat Chair (৳2,200 / ৳4,300)
- **Cabins:** Bunker Bed — 2-person category, from ৳4,100 one way; Deluxe Cabin — 2 persons, from ৳7,000 one way; Family Bunker Cabin — 4 persons, from ৳8,500 one way; VIP Cabin — 2 persons, from ৳8,500 one way; VVIP Cabin — 2 persons, from ৳10,500 one way
- **Facilities:** AC seating (selected categories), Open-view deck seating, Indoor seating, Common washrooms, Attached washroom (selected cabins), Cabin accommodation, Food / restaurant service, Passenger service areas
- **Journey:** Approx. 2 hours
- **Departure:** Date and tide dependent — published schedules vary by sailing date
- **Check-in:** Approx. 1 hour before departure (follow the time printed on your ticket)

- **Page:** [https://www.shiptickets.bd/saint-martin-ship/keari-sindbad](https://www.shiptickets.bd/saint-martin-ship/keari-sindbad)

- **Round-trip fare (reference):** From ৳3,500

- **Cabins:** No private cabin inventory is published for this vessel
- **Facilities:** Passenger seating, Open viewing areas, Canteen / food service, Audio facilities, Passenger security arrangements, Life rafts, Life jackets, Life buoys, Rescue boat
- **Journey:** Not published as a fixed duration; varies by date, route, weather, sea conditions and tide
- **Departure:** Previously published 7:00 AM with 6:45 AM reporting (reference only, confirm for your travel date)
- **Specifications:** Built by Western Marine Shipyard, launched 22 January 2004. Length 34.10 m, beam 7.62 m, depth 2.77 m, total published seating 346 passengers.
- **Check-in:** 30 minutes before departure

### 4. Keari Cruise & Dine (কেয়ারী ক্রুজ অ্যান্ড ডাইন)

- **Page:** [https://www.shiptickets.bd/saint-martin-ship/keari-cruise-dine](https://www.shiptickets.bd/saint-martin-ship/keari-cruise-dine)

- **Operator:** Keari Tours & Services Ltd.
- **Status:** Needs confirmation — 2026-2027 season opens 1 November 2026
- **Last reviewed:** 5 October 2026
- **One-way fare (reference):** From ৳2,075
- **Round-trip fare (reference):** From ৳4,000
- **Ticket classes:** Exclusive Lounge (৳2,075 / ৳4,000), Coral Lounge (৳2,325 / ৳4,500), Pearl Lounge (৳2,575 / ৳5,000)
- **Cabins:** Published Keari information focuses on Pearl, Coral and Exclusive lounge seating. No private cabin inventory is published for this vessel — confirm current availability before booking.
- **Facilities:** Air-conditioned lounges, Floating restaurant, Buffet facilities, Sky deck, Grand lobby, Conference / event facilities, Safety equipment (life rafts, life jackets, life buoys)
- **Journey:** Varies by route, tide and sea conditions — use your date-specific schedule
- **Departure:** Seasonal — reporting and departure time confirmed for your date
- **Check-in:** Reporting time confirmed on your ticket or booking confirmation
- **Cabin note:** Published Keari information focuses on Pearl, Coral and Exclusive lounge seating. No private cabin inventory is published for this vessel — confirm current availability before booking.

Four vessels operate this route: MV Karnafuly Express, MV Baro Awlia, Keari Sindbad and Keari Cruise & Dine. MV Bay Cruiser 1 and MV Bay One are both retired from the route and publish no current fare, class or schedule data.

## Ticket price reference

Saint Martin ship ticket prices are not a single fixed number. The fare depends on the ship, ticket class, cabin type, one-way vs round-trip, travel date and current season.

Full breakdown: [Saint Martin ship ticket price guide](https://www.shiptickets.bd/saint-martin-ship-ticket-price)

Cabin and class detail: [Saint Martin ship cabin and seat class prices](https://www.shiptickets.bd/saint-martin-cabin-price)

| Ship | One-way (from) | Round-trip (from) |
|---|---|---|
| MV Karnafuly Express | ৳1,800 | ৳3,500 |
| MV Baro Awlia | ৳1,800 | ৳3,500 |
| Keari Sindbad | ৳1,825 | ৳3,500 |
| Keari Cruise & Dine | ৳2,075 | ৳4,000 |

**Cabin fares (reference, per ship):**

| Ship & cabin | Capacity | One-way | Round-trip |
|---|---|---|---|
| MV Karnafuly Express — Single Cabin | 1 passenger | ৳3,300 | ৳6,500 |
| MV Karnafuly Express — Twin Cabin | 2 passengers | ৳7,000 | ৳13,000 |
| MV Karnafuly Express — VIP Cabin | Private cabin | ৳8,500 | ৳16,000 |
| MV Karnafuly Express — VVIP Cabin | Private cabin | ৳10,500 | ৳20,000 |
| MV Baro Awlia — Bunker Bed | 2-person category | ৳4,100 | ৳8,000 |
| MV Baro Awlia — Deluxe Cabin | 2 persons | ৳7,000 | ৳13,000 |
| MV Baro Awlia — Family Bunker Cabin | 4 persons | ৳8,500 | ৳16,000 |
| MV Baro Awlia — VIP Cabin | 2 persons | ৳8,500 | ৳16,000 |
| MV Baro Awlia — VVIP Cabin | 2 persons | ৳10,500 | ৳20,000 |

**Ticket class types across ships:**

- **Open Deck / Sun Deck / Main Deck** — outdoor or deck-level seating. On some vessels this is the cheapest fare, while on others a named Economy seat is cheaper, so compare the fare table
- **Business seat / chair** — air-conditioned seating above the economy decks
- **Economy seat** — lower-cost indoor or outdoor seating
- **Lounge** — premium indoor comfort seating
- **Bunker bed** — shared berth accommodation, usually per person
- **VIP / VVIP cabin** — premium private accommodation

> All fares above are **reference values** and are **not live prices**. Confirm the exact fare, cabin basis (per person vs per cabin) and availability for your travel date before payment.

---

## Ship schedule

Ship departure and return times are seasonal and operator-specific. Do not rely on a departure time copied from a previous year.

Full details: [Saint Martin ship schedule and status](https://www.shiptickets.bd/saint-martin-ship-schedule)

**What to confirm before travel:**

1. Approved departure jetty in Cox's Bazar (BIWTA Nuniachhara Jetty)
2. Check-in / boarding time for your sailing
3. Journey duration — varies by vessel, roughly 2 to 5 hours
4. Return sailing date and time
5. Weather or tide-related changes
6. Travel Pass and QR ticket requirements

**Schedule status:** Seasonal confirmation required. The 2026-2027 season opens 1 November 2026. Information last reviewed: 5 October 2026.

---

## Travel Pass and QR ticket

Guide: [Saint Martin Travel Pass](https://www.shiptickets.bd/saint-martin-travel-pass)

- The Saint Martin **Travel Pass** is the travel authorization or pass used under applicable government rules for visitors to Saint Martin Island, Bangladesh.
- **QR-coded tickets** may be required alongside the Travel Pass.
- Requirements can change between seasons.
- Use only a valid ticket issued through an authorized process and verify the details before departure.
- Ensure passenger names on the ticket match your ID.

---

## Travel rules

Guide: [Saint Martin travel rules](https://www.shiptickets.bd/saint-martin-travel-rules)

Saint Martin Island access is seasonal and regulated. The island is typically closed February–October. Check before booking:

- Whether the island is open for tourism in your planned month — the 2026-2027 season opens 1 November 2026
- Daily visitor and overnight stay limits
- Travel Pass and QR ticket requirements
- Approved jetty and vessel list (BIWTA Nuniachhara Jetty, Cox's Bazar)
- Environmental protections and restricted items (no plastic, no barbecues, no motorized vehicles on beach)
- Weather and sea-condition notices

Saint Martin is a sensitive marine environment. Follow local authority instructions, avoid single-use plastic where restricted, and do not damage coral or wildlife.

---

## How booking works (human-assisted)

Route basics: [Cox's Bazar to Saint Martin route guide](https://www.shiptickets.bd/routes/coxs-bazar-to-saint-martin)

1. **Share your date** — Tell us your travel date, passenger count and preferred ticket type or ship.
2. **Compare options** — We help you check the latest fare, class, cabin and sailing details.
3. **Book on WhatsApp** — Confirm the final details (fare, availability, Travel Pass) before making payment.

The frontend does not process payments or hold real-time inventory. Final booking confirmation is done by a human support agent.

---

## FAQ — quick answers

**How much is a Saint Martin ship ticket?**
Fares vary by ship, ticket class, cabin type, travel date and whether you need a one-way or round-trip ticket. Reference seating-class one-way fares range from ৳1,800 to ৳2,900 depending on the ship and class. Private cabins are quoted separately and cost more. Check the latest verified fare on WhatsApp before booking.

**কক্সবাজার থেকে সেন্টমার্টিন কোন জাহাজ যায়?**
Multiple passenger ships operate this route seasonally: MV Karnafuly Express, MV Baro Awlia, Keari Sindbad, Keari Cruise & Dine . Operating status changes by season — the 2026-2027 season opens 1 November 2026.

**When does the Saint Martin ship season start?**
The 2026-2027 tourist season opens on 1 November 2026. Outside the season the island is closed to visitors and ships do not sail.

**Do I need a Travel Pass for Saint Martin?**
Yes, a Travel Pass and possibly a QR-coded ticket are typically required under current government rules. Requirements change with the season. Read the latest guidance before confirming your journey.

**Can I book a Saint Martin ship ticket by WhatsApp?**
Yes. Send your travel date, passenger count and preferred ship or class to our WhatsApp number. Our support team will help confirm current availability and fare.

**Is the fare one-way or round-trip?**
Both are available. One-way covers Cox's Bazar → Saint Martin. Round-trip covers the return journey. Confirm the return date, boarding time and ticket conditions before paying.

**What is the difference between open deck, lounge and cabin?**
Open deck is outdoor seating. Lounge is indoor comfort seating. Cabin is private or family accommodation (single, twin, VIP, VVIP) — subject to availability and often quoted per person.

**How do I reach the jetty in Cox's Bazar?**
The exact jetty and check-in counter vary by operator and season. Confirm the approved departure point (BIWTA Nuniachhara Jetty) with our support team before you leave.

**কত টাকায় সেন্টমার্টিন জাহাজ টিকিট পাবো?**
জাহাজ, seat category, cabin, travel date এবং one-way বা round-trip অনুযায়ী ভাড়া পরিবর্তিত হয়। রেফারেন্স one-way fare ৳১,৮০০ থেকে ৳২,৯০০ পর্যন্ত হতে পারে (seating class অনুযায়ী), আর private cabin-এর ভাড়া আলাদা। ২০২৬-২০২৭ সিজন ১ নভেম্বর ২০২৬ থেকে শুরু। পেমেন্টের আগে WhatsApp-এ বর্তমান ভাড়া নিশ্চিত করুন।

**সেন্টমার্টিন ট্রাভেল পাস কী?**
এটি সেন্টমার্টিন আইল্যান্ডে আবেদনকারী সরকারি ভিজিটরদের জন্য প্রয়োজনীয় ভ্রমণ অনুমোদন। টিকিটের সাথে QR কোড থাকতে পারে। সীজন পরিবর্তে প্রয়োজনীয়তা পরিবর্তিত হতে পারে।

**কি আমি অনলাইন বুকিং করতে পারি?**
আমরা লাইভ বুকিং ইঞ্জিন চালাই না। আপনার তথ্য শেয়ার করুন, আমরা আপনার জন্য সর্বশেষ স্ট্যাটাস এবং ভাড়া নিশ্চিত করব। শেষ বুকিং WhatsApp বা ফোনে হয়।
